answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond tied to its onyx token serial for one velvet ballot envelope, then casts a ballot posted on the mirror tally board by serial. An auditor recomputes the tally from mirror board and registry; a missing token, reused serial, or mismatch burns the bond. The first filing costs 33, the kth 33+6(k-1), the 1000th 6027, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,030,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-ballot ring fails because a rented ballot carries its owner's onyx token, and a second filing under another key triggers a double burn. An honest voter pays 33 once and recovers the bond.
